name: QA: Speech Rendering Unsafe
description: Boolean QA metric: true only if assistant speech included raw digits or non-speech-safe rendering.

schema.description: True only if an assistant reply meant for the caller left raw digit characters in spoken dates, times, phone numbers, prices, or treatment names, or used non-speech-safe forms such as 9:00, 29 kwietnia, All-on-4, a literal URL/domain, or similar. Ignore technical tool arguments, tool results, system messages, and caller speech.
